integrity: Finite tests do not replace the analytic proof. No claim of independent audit, original authorship, or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite one-dimensional cyclic Ising graph; real bond couplings with K>0 on n-1 bonds and arbitrary L on the final bond; uniform complex fugacity; not multidefect, graphs, zero-angle enumeration, or thermodynamic-limit claims. Existing 2026 work already gives the Chebyshev expression, which is not asserted novel. Numerical tests support but do not certify all parameter cases. Independent publication priority is unresolved.
title: Parity-sharp Lee–Yang circle boundary for a single frustrated bond in an Ising ring
